'''Maureen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Maureen got a job working in the [[Space Monkey Café]], a bar that was located in the city of [[Bayonard]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. She had worked there two weeks when the [[heroes of Cularin]] visited the bar, while they were investigating the disappearance of [[Selima DeWitt]].
